caption:
Google quietly retired the GBP Q&A box.

In its place: Ask Maps, a Gemini-powered feature that answers customer questions about your business in real time. No thread to scroll.

You don't write the answer anymore. The AI does. It pulls from your profile fields, your website, your reviews.

Thin or stale reviews mean thin or wrong answers surface when a lead asks about emergency calls, licensing, or financing.

This week: search your own business on Maps. Ask it what your leads actually ask you. Fix whatever's thin at the source.

The review half runs itself once collection is automated.

rationale: Fills the under-served News/Industry Intelligence slot with a genuinely unclaimed, verified Google product change (Q&A retired for AI-generated Ask Maps answers), interpreted through the review-engine capability this account hasn't tied to news before, in the reel format research shows still wins reach for cold-audience news content.
